typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

rootSourceStatus.description: A reference to {@link SourceStatus} of the initial / root Sources. Will be `null` for root SourceStatus.

parentStatus.description:
Returns a reference to the parentStatus object, which is a {@see SourceStatus}, {@see SourceChunkStatus}, or
{@see TransformStatus} object.

transforms.description: Array of statuses of immediate transforms optionally filtered by provided transform type.

targets.description: Array of statuses of immediate targets optionally filtered by provided transform type.

sourceType.description: The {@see TypeRef} of the Sources for which the stats are being stored

specId.description: fingerprint id of the {@see DataIntegSpec} for fetching the corresponding merged specs.

spec.description: {@link DataIntegSpec} for the corresponding merged specs.

state.description:
Specifies the current state of the current data integration step. See {@link SourcesState} for the different
state transitions.

count.description: The number of objects participating at this data integration step.

successful.description: The number of objects successfully processed at this data integration step.

skipped.description: The number of objects that were skipped at this data integration step.

failed.description: The number of objects that failed to process at this data integration step.

totalErrorCount.description:
The total count of errors (including downstream errors) encountered when attempting to transform / persist sources
from this stage of the data integration pipeline.

errors.description: List of first 100 errors in this data integration step.

firstError.description:
Error Msg up to 4000 characters to give insights into the actual failure, rather than going through the entire
rejected (or) failed sources.

targetType.description: Target type of this status. Note that if this is a SourceStatus then #targetType field will be same as #sourceType.

dbStats.description: Database operation statistics if this target is Persistable, otherwise `null`.

title:
The following captures the statistics for targets in the data integration process. Target can either be a Persistable
entity type or a Source type.
name: TargetStatus
